scope: Independent frozen-development metric recomputation and descriptive signed-error analysis; prospective V1 proposal only
signed_error_convention: Prediction minus true camera-axis Z; positive means too far, negative means too close. Same log/track/observation weighting as the frozen primary MAE.
findings: Every eligible evaluated 0-2m point in both classes is overestimated. Vehicle close-range overestimation occurs in all twelve development recording logs; Pedestrian 0-2m support is only eight tracks across three logs.

Vehicle 2-4m average signed error is positive in all twelve development logs. Average 4-6m signed errors are negative for both classes, so subtracting a global distance offset would not address both ranges.

The pinned prior training input manifest explicitly has depth_min_m=2. Its reviewed 1536-image training pool spans five training logs. Lack of below-2m supervision is confirmed; its causal share of the error is not established.

No eligible CAM_FRONT 0-2m reference exists for either class in this frozen development selection. Vehicle 0-1m is absent; Pedestrian 0-1m has one track in one log. No reliable front-camera sub-2m or general sub-1m performance claim is possible.
Camera-specific primary scores range from about 0.693 to 1.082m, but camera slices contain different objects and depths, so this is not a causal ranking of cameras.
Removing one recording log at a time changes the primary score to 0.732-0.795m. This is descriptive sensitivity, not a confidence interval; no log is removed from the actual benchmark.
v1_recommendation: Prepare new frozen training-only 0-6m sparse GT from the 34 available training logs, maintaining the existing dev/held-out boundaries and archive-first I/O. Then prospectively test matched 1920-update adapter-only continuation-control and six-cell close-range-supervision arms, both starting from unchanged V0. Keep architecture, detection, base decoder, all BN state and numerical scoring identities unchanged. The recipe is proposed, not executed.

tests.runtime_note: Benchmark integration tests require the existing pinned ijson 3.4.0.post0 metadata runtime; after supplying that task-local dependency all eighteen passed.
